title: Profiler
summary: An OEDISI power-distribution-system profiler that loads OpenDSS feeder models and their loadshape/pvshape profiles to generate new synthetic time-series profiles, primarily via TimeGAN. A separate notebook (workflow_profiler.ipynb) instead builds an sdv.metadata.Metadata schema and runs SDV's PARSynthesizer to generate synthetic sequential load/PV profiles.
evidence: workflow_profiler.ipynb: 'from sdv.sequential import PARSynthesizer' ... 'synthesizer = PARSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100, ...)'
needs: README emphasizes TSGM.TimeGAN as the main pipeline; SDV's PARSynthesizer appears only in a secondary notebook workflow
